title: fix(cli): show backup namespace remedy in JSON errors
body:
## What Problem This Solves

`openclaw backup verify <archive> --namespace n --json` and `backup restore` without `--from` hide the existing remedy on stderr behind a generic failure and Doctor hint.

## User Impact

Both commands now print `--namespace requires --from <location>.` on stderr in JSON mode, just as they already do in text mode. JSON stdout, exit codes and remote backup routing are unchanged.

## Why This Change Was Made

Route the existing guard through `throwExpectedCliError`; the predicate, message and command dispatch stay unchanged.

## Evidence

- Source CLI, isolated home/profile, no Gateway: reproduced on main `091312a21c1a` and verified the fix for both commands, each in JSON and text mode. Restore used its required `--target` option.
- JSON stdout is byte-identical before/after, including the existing message; all failure exits remain 1. Text output is identical. With `--from` and `--namespace`, both versions reach the same remote-key validation instead of this guard.
- Registration regression fails against unchanged main production code and passes with the fix. The original `git log --limit 1oops` rejection-before-dispatch case is retained beside it in the same table; no test case was deleted. Shorter synthetic SQLite path fixtures preserve every dispatch assertion while keeping tests net -1. Production +2/-1.
- Focused tests, command-test typecheck leaf, targeted lint/format, full build and packed CLI smoke are recorded in the proof comment.

This is a two-way door: reverting restores the prior error classification. No state, config, policy or output wording changes. Blast radius is the shared verify/restore missing-`--from` guard.
